name: coding-toolbox
description: Mechanically enforces the Interaction axis on Stop, blocks content operations on non-UTF-8 files with an encoding hint, refreshes a newly-created worktree from its default branch on origin (toggle: worktree_refresh), and provides fresh-branch, fresh-pr, finish-pr, fresh-work, feature-development, debugging, bump-version, setup-rules, refresh-tools-rule, setup-explore and dispatch-agent skills — fresh-work classifies a unit of work and dispatches to debugging (fix path) or feature-development (design path, for both feature and refactor: design/plan/implement/review) before opening a PR via fresh-pr; finish-pr finalizes an already-open PR/MR before merge (rebase onto its base and force-push if behind, undraft, GitLab delete-source-branch-on-merge, title/description reconciliation); setup-rules installs the golden behavior rules doc (Interaction/Language/Behavior/Mentality) and a tool-routing table as opt-in user-level rules (every project on this machine, also invocable non-interactively via a verbatim argument), refresh-tools-rule is its narrow, model-invocable, non-destructive companion for refreshing an already-installed tool-routing rule, setup-explore installs a user-level ~/.claude/agents/explore.md, choosing between a plain and a codebase-memory-mcp-aware variant based on whether that MCP server is detected on the machine, and dispatch-agent hands off an independent task to a new worktree-isolated background Claude Code session (`claude --worktree ... --bg`) started from the repo's default branch on origin — for self-contained git branch, PR/MR, end-to-end work pipeline, semver version-bump, user-level rules/explore-agent setup management, and background-session dispatch.

worktree_refresh.title: Worktree refresh on EnterWorktree
worktree_refresh.description: When EnterWorktree creates a new worktree (not when switching into an existing one), fetches and rebases it onto the repo's default branch on origin. Values: true (or unset) = enabled; false = disabled — the worktree_refresh hook no-ops immediately, no git commands run. Fail-open: only the literal value false disables it. Default: true.
